(Followers that move by derivation and need NO line edit beyond the annotation above:
`GFX_CS_M1 = GFX_PSTK`, `GFX_CS_M2 = GFX_CS_M1 + 4`, `GFX_PSP/PBASE/PFLOOR = GFX_PSTK + 8/10/12`,
`RDV_LINE = DEFT_PTR`, `RDV_VAL = DEFT_PTR + 2`, `RDV_ST = RDV_VAL + 2`, `ISRCH_B = ISRCH_A + 2`.
`GFX_PSP`/`GFX_PBASE`/`GFX_PFLOOR` carry no `; $XXXX:` annotation, so they need no edit at all.
`CVT_MODE`'s continuation line `; 1=address domain (1)` stays as is — the `(1)` there is what
ram_map then reads; with `int16` gone the cell is 1 B and `$F11F` is freed.)

## 2. `basic/sysvars.inc` — append after the S11 host-fit guards (end of file, after line 5551)

```
; --- D-WSZERO S12: the overlay-fit guards --------------------------------------
; 89 transient cells now OVERLAY four hosts whose own users provably never run
; while they are live (scratchpad/s12_plan.md): BUF (the graphics draw-phase
; cells DRAW never touches, + RENUM), the DEF FN shadow slots (statement-only
; cells with no expression evaluation in their live range), MULPROD+DIVPAD (the
; scratch of leaf routines that never nest), and FBUFFR's idle bytes. Each guard
; pins a LAYOUT fact one of those proofs relies on; 0 ROM bytes.
    IF GFX_POVF < LINEBUF
                db      S12_BUF_GUESTS_BELOW_BUF
    ENDIF
    IF RN_OLD + 2 > LINEBUF + 258
                db      S12_BUF_GUESTS_OVERRAN_BUF
    ENDIF
    IF GFX_PFLOOR + 2 > GFX_PPITCH
                db      S12_PAINT_UNION_OVERRAN_INTO_PPITCH
    ENDIF
    IF PU_NUM < FN_PAREA
                db      S12_FN_GUESTS_BELOW_THE_SHADOW_SLOTS
    ENDIF
    IF TKLNUM + 1 > FN_PAREA_END
                db      S12_FN_GUESTS_OVERRAN_INTO_FPERR
    ENDIF
    IF RL_HL < $F7A9
                db      S12_READLINE_CELLS_INSIDE_DISKROM_BDOS_CONSOLE_SCRATCH
    ENDIF
    IF TKDIG < MULPROD
                db      S12_LEAF_GUESTS_BELOW_MULPROD
    ENDIF
    IF TKSRCSAVE + 2 > DIVPAD + 15
                db      S12_TK_CELLS_OVERRAN_INTO_WSRC
    ENDIF
    IF GFX_VBUF + 32 > DIVPAD + 15
                db      S12_SPRITE_STAGING_OVERRAN_INTO_WSRC
    ENDIF
    IF FP_OPMODE + 1 > DIVPAD + 15
                db      S12_OPMODE_OVERRAN_INTO_WSRC
    ENDIF
    IF (high TKDIG) != (high (TKDIG + 23))
                db      S12_TKDIG_CROSSES_A_PAGE__DETOK_CP_LOW_TKDIG
    ENDIF
; co-live pairs (one routine holds both): they may NOT share a byte
    IF MUL_I < MULPROD + 28
                db      S12_MUL_I_INSIDE_FP_MULS_OWN_PRODUCT
    ENDIF
    IF MUL_PP < MUL_I + 1
                db      S12_MUL_PP_ON_MUL_I
    ENDIF
    IF WIDIG + 5 > MUL_I
                db      S12_WIDIG_ON_MUL_I__WIDEN_UINT_TO_HOLDS_BOTH
    ENDIF
    IF FP_SHIFTAMT + 1 > DIVPAD
                db      S12_SHIFTAMT_INSIDE_FP_DIVS_DIVPAD
    ENDIF
    IF WIDIG + 5 > PLF_RA
                db      S12_WIDIG_ON_PLF__CADDSUB_HOLDS_FP_OPMODE_ACROSS_BOTH
    ENDIF
    IF MUL_PP + 2 > FP_OPMODE
                db      S12_MUL_PP_ON_FP_OPMODE
    ENDIF
    IF FP_OPMODE < PLF_RA2 + 2
                db      S12_FP_OPMODE_ON_PLF
    ENDIF
    IF DIVREM < FOUTBUF + 24
                db      S12_DIVREM_INSIDE_FOUTBUF
    ENDIF
    IF DIVREM + 15 > LHS_FAC
                db      S12_DIVREM_ON_LHS_FAC
    ENDIF
    IF LHS_FAC + 8 > LHS_FACTYP
                db      S12_LHS_FAC_ON_LHS_FACTYP
    ENDIF
    IF LHS_FACTYP + 1 > DAC
                db      S12_LHS_FRAME_OVERRAN_INTO_DAC
    ENDIF
    IF TKOVF != FBUFFR
                db      S12_TKOVF_LEFT_FBUFFR_0
    ENDIF
```
All 23 evaluate FALSE on the planned layout (checked by hand against `sim.out` §1; most hold with zero slack,
e.g. `MUL_I < MULPROD + 28` is `$F846 < $F846`). `!=` and
`(high X)` are already used in this file (lines 1031, 4465); `$F7A9` is a literal because
`INT_SP_SAVE`/`CONIN_*` are disk-component names basic does not see.

## 4. `probes/basic/basic_probe_wszero.py` — the S12 rows (insert after line 142, `KNOWN_DIVERGE = set()`)

```python
# D-WSZERO S12: 89 transient cells OVERLAY four hosts (BUF, the DEF FN shadow
# slots, MULPROD+DIVPAD, FBUFFR's idle bytes). As S11: load $A5 over the whole
# window, run every user of one group, sum the 290 bytes S12 vacated (the pre-S12
# homes, frozen here: 27 spans) -- the VG-8020 leaves them alone: 165 * 290 = 47850.
# The ov* rows sum nothing: each runs a host's users and its guests' users
# interleaved in ONE program (the closest-to-breaking shapes, s12_plan.md §5) and
# must read as the VG-8020 does.
for _r in ("s12gfx", "s12num", "s12inp", "s12dir", "ovbuf", "ovfn", "ovleaf", "ovfbuf"):
    RANGES[_r] = RANGES["all"]
S12_SPANS_A = "60664,60667,60671,60723,60815,60819,60825,60825,61037,61038,61041,61042,61085,61116,61119,61119,61121,61122,61130,61161,61183,61189,61296,61324,61335,61362"
S12_SPANS_B = "61373,61374,61405,61406,61416,61419,61599,61599,61608,61609,61611,61637,61642,61645,61647,61648,61653,61669,61688,61697,61703,61708,61711,61720,61725,61725,61727,61730"
_S12_SUM = ['900 SCREEN 0:S=0:RESTORE 950:FOR K=1 TO 27:READ P,Q:FOR I=P TO Q:S=S+PEEK(I):NEXT:NEXT'
            ':PRINT"[S";S;"]":END',
            "950 DATA " + S12_SPANS_A, "951 DATA " + S12_SPANS_B]
RUN_GAP.update({"s12gfx": 60.0, "s12num": 60.0, "s12dir": 60.0})
TAPES["s12dir"] = lambda: tape(*RANGES["s12dir"]) + build_cas_ascii("M", '30 PRINT"[M]"\r\n')
```

```python
    '20 A=1/3:B$=STR$(-2/3):C=1.5*2.25:D#=-1.23456789012345D-12:PRINT"[Q";A;B$;C;D#;-7/3;"]":END',
    "RUN",
]
```
and extend `PROGRAMS` (line 322) with
`"s12gfx": PROGRAM_S12GFX, "s12num": PROGRAM_S12NUM, "s12inp": PROGRAM_S12INP, "s12dir": PROGRAM_S12DIR,
"ovbuf": PROGRAM_OVBUF, "ovfn": PROGRAM_OVFN, "ovleaf": PROGRAM_OVLEAF, "ovfbuf": PROGRAM_OVFBUF`.

**(unverified)**: the harness's handling of two typed answers (`"4.2", "HI"`) and of raw keys for
`INPUT$(24)`; that a `build_cas_ascii` image appended to a binary one is read by `MERGE"CAS:"` as
the next file; run times (s12gfx PAINTs a 20-radius circle and sums 290 B: 60 s gap, as S11).

## 5. Prose the move falsifies (no gate reads prose — [[a-fix-falsifies-the-justification-beside-it]])

- `basic/sysvars.inc:702-708` (G3 header) — *"THE ALIASING ARGUMENT THIS BLOCK USED TO CARRY IS
  RETIRED … must not be re-derived by a later reader as a live constraint"*: S12 RE-DERIVES it,
  for the box cells only; invert it (BUF is dead during a LINE/CIRCLE/PAINT draw because those
  statements take no string argument, every STRSCR value is consumed before the tenant runs,
  and no graphics op the evaluator can reach — POINT, SPRITE$ — touches these cells; the
  Bresenham cells went to the FN slots because DRAW reads an INPUT$ argument IN PLACE in STRSCR).
- `:732` (G4) and `:790` (G5) — "the LINEBUF overlay … is retired": same inversion.
- `:2133-2160` GFX_PSTK block ("the graphics UNION's base", "What still time-shares it is 44 B",
  "+0 is the CS_M1/DBUF/PSTK/VBUF group"): the union is now 14 B in BUF; VBUF left it.
- `:2185-2199` CS_M1/M2 ("They ALIAS the same span-stack window …"), `:2244-2250` G7 VBUF ("It
  ALIASES the PAINT span stack / DRAW frame buffer"): VBUF overlays MULPROD now (§3.3 proof).
- `:2280-2340` DEFT_PTR / RDV_* / TGT_ADDR "Same window and the same one-statement-at-a-time
  aliasing argument": RDV_*/DEFT_PTR overlay PU_DIG's head in the FN slots now.
- `:3995-3998` PU_NUM/PU_DIG, `:4310-4318` RL_*, `:886-888` TKLNUM/MRG_PTR, `:1480-1486` SV_*,
  `:1675-1684` PLN_*, `:3500-3507` RN_*, `:2040-2058` ISRCH_*/STRENG_SPARE, `:3776-3786` PLAY parse
  cells (incl. PLY_NUMOVF's S9b note), `:4527` TKOVF, `:4583-4600` TKDIG ("own choice — free
  RAM"), `:4546-4553` FBUFFR ("FBUFFR+0 is not written" — TKOVF lives there now), `:4696-4747`
  DIVREM/LHS_*/MUL*/WIDIG/PLF_*/FP_OPMODE ("own choice … free RAM"): each gets its host and the
  one-line exclusivity reason (s12_plan.md §3).
- `docs/ram-map.md` is generated: `make ram-map-doc`.
- `docs/sysvar-msx1-coverage.md` (sysvarsweep EXTRA counts): zerobas now writes BUF / PARM2 /
  HOLD8 / FBUFFR in states the VG-8020 does not — doc drift, magnitude unmeasured.
